en.plugins.socialdl.desc: Download media from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, Pinterest and Reddit
en.plugins.socialdl.usage:
*Social Media Downloader*

{0}dl <link>: detect the platform and download
{0}dl <link> audio: audio only

You can also reply to a message that contains the link.

*Supported platforms:*
• TikTok
• Instagram (posts, reels, stories)
• Facebook
• X (Twitter)
• YouTube
• Pinterest
• Reddit
en.plugins.socialdl.unsupported: ❌ Unsupported platform. Supported: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit.
en.plugins.socialdl.failed: ❌ Download failed. The content may be private or unavailable.
